newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bau Holding 95/96 net down 53%, cuts div.
newsitem.headline: Bau Holding 95/96 net down 53%, cuts div.

text.p: Austrian construction firm Bau Holding AG said on Tuesday group net profit for the year ending March 31, 1996, tumbled 53 percent to 202.7 million schillings, adding it would slash its dividend by five schillings.

Sales, including proceeds from cooperations, slipped to 14.42 billion schillings from 16.07 billion schillings in the year-ago period, while pre-tax profit fell to 224.4 million schillings from 482.3 million.
Bau Holding slashed its dividend on ordinary shares to 15 schillings from 10, and to 15 from 20 on its preferred shares.
In a statement, Bau Holding said it does not reckon with a real decline in earnings for the 1996/97 year.
